name: yf_calendar
description:
Upcoming earnings and dividend events for one ticker from Yahoo Finance (yfinance calendar).
Returns: {symbol, calendar} where calendar holds keys such as Dividend Date, Ex-Dividend Date, Earnings Date (list), Earnings High/Low/Average and Revenue High/Low/Average; empty when Yahoo has none.
Inputs (* required): symbol* (Yahoo ticker, e.g. AAPL, BRK-B, 7203.T).
Past and future earnings dates with EPS: yf_earnings_dates; market-wide calendars: openbb_equity_calendar_earnings, openbb_equity_calendar_dividend.
Example: {"symbol": "MSFT"}
